data.translation: Father Brahim: Certainly, it was cool. We had tents; it was certainly hot. It was hot, but we were at the edge of the plain, Jan. That is, it was fine; the place was normal. It was not very... It was certainly hot and it was not very...

In the same MAC Famine/69 verse, dependent fayḥi contrasts with later fayiḥi. Finite feminine fayiḥo/fayḥo must not be reboxed solely because masculine adjectival fayiḥo has a similar spelling; supplied Part act. feminine is fayəḥto.
